verdicts.reason: A puts the 'Taste the Glow' CTA in the top-left corner, ahead of the product and headline, so the reading order is backwards. Its logo sits off-axis to the top right, the bottom third is dead space, and the legal line is microscopic. B keeps a sensible order (product, brand, headline, copy, CTA), but it mixes alignments: the logo and CTA are centred while the headline and body are flush left. The box also crowds the top edge, the bottom is somewhat empty, and the legal text is still illegibly small.
